cs.t: Another sound engineer weighing in - AKG makes some great headphones. You'd be hard-pressed to find a studio without at least a few pairs of AKG 240's hanging around. I suspect they're a bit over $100 regularly priced, but a good sale should get them closer to your budget. I love my 240s...
cs.th: Ask HN: Any Headphone Recommendations For Around $100 US?
